column1: # DuckDB v1.1.3 (19864453f7) as e2e victim. Panel-session measurements, 2026-08-21.
# All victim runs: single DuckDB thread (SET threads=1), pinned via numactl --physcpubind, --membind as stated.
# Query shapes: chain8 = many-to-many join, build=N rows over N/8 distinct keys, probe=10M rows (100M where noted).
# Times = per-query "Run Time (s)" from DuckDB .timer; first sample of each invocation discarded.
# --- A. MLP=1 pointer-chase latency ladder (cxl_join_bench --mode latency), ns
# --- B. DuckDB build-size sweep, node0, 100M probe rows, unique keys: ns per probe tuple
# perf on build_2000000: l1d_pend_miss.pending/pending_cycles = 4.23 (effective MLP); dtlb_load_misses.walk_active = 22% of cycles
# --- C. CAT capacity-sensitivity gate: full mask vs 1 way, n=3
# --- D. Real co-run, victim tables on CXL node 2, full LLC mask, n=10 or n=6 (first dropped)
